CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Unfiltered MIN of subscription start date across all quote lines. Fallback for the ELV Day 1 ARR Start Date cascade when no line passes the ARR include filter (1,694 such quotes in the CPQ regression population). Distinct from ELV Min Start Date, which is a writable field read by OrderTriggerUtility for NetSuite order events.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Earliest subscription start date across all lines, no filter.
CustomField.label: All Lines Min Start Date
